task.name: Content Method Elicitation
task.description: Apply content creation methods to improve drafts, generate ideas, or refine strategy. Use during any BMAD content workflow (A-F).

llm.i: MANDATORY: Execute ALL steps in the flow section IN EXACT ORDER
DO NOT skip steps or change the sequence
HALT immediately when halt-conditions are met
Each action xml tag within step xml tag is a REQUIRED action
Methods define HOW (process). Vocabulary CSVs define WHAT (options/ingredients).
When a method references hooks, formats, tones, CTAs, etc. — pull options from the vocabulary CSVs
YOU MUST ALWAYS SPEAK in the agent's communication style and language

integration.description: When called from BMAD content workflows
integration.desc: Can be invoked during any SMA BMAD workflow:
integration.i: A-ContentIdeation: Use ideation, research, creative methods
B-ContentDrafting: Use narrative, hook, engagement methods
F-ContentFormatting: Use repurposing, engagement, creative methods
C-ContentReview: Use analytics, engagement methods to evaluate
Standalone: User asks for brainstorming or strategy refinement

vocabulary-linking.description: How methods connect to CSV vocabulary
vocabulary-linking.i: Methods are RECIPES. Vocabulary CSVs are INGREDIENTS.
When executing a method that needs specific options:
- "Hook Stress Test" → load hook-frameworks.csv → pick 5 diverse hooks
- "Content Waterfall" → load content-formats.csv → pick format per channel
- "Tone Mirroring" → load tone-frameworks.csv → match audience voice
- "Reply Bait Architecture" → load cta-frameworks.csv → pick CTA type
If a method does not map to a vocabulary CSV, execute purely from method description

step.title: Context Analysis and Method Loading
step.action: Load content-methods.csv and all vocabulary CSVs

context-analysis.i: - Which BMAD workflow is active? (A/B/F/C/D/E or standalone)
- What content exists so far? (topic only? draft? formatted? published?)
- What is the target channel? (LinkedIn, Substack, Instagram, Reel, etc.)
- What is the user's current challenge? (stuck on ideas? hook weak? low engagement?)
- What methods were already applied this session?

smart-selection.i: 1. Map user's current challenge to method categories
2. Parse method descriptions to find best matches
3. Select 5 methods: prioritize by relevance to current situation
5. Never repeat methods already applied this session

step.title: Present Options and Handle Responses
step.format:
**Content Method Lab** 🧪 Choose a method (1-5), [r] Reshuffle, [a] All Methods, or [x] Done:
1. [emoji] [Method Name] — [one-line description] 2. [emoji] [Method Name] — [one-line description] 3. [emoji] [Method Name] — [one-line description] 4. [emoji] [Method Name] — [one-line description] 5. [emoji] [Method Name] — [one-line description] r. Reshuffle with 5 new methods a. List all 60 methods by category x. Done — proceed with current content

case.i: Execute the selected method:
1. Load method description and output_pattern from CSV
2. If method maps to vocabulary CSV — load relevant options
3. Apply method to current content/situation
4. Follow the output_pattern flow (→ arrows guide the process)
5. Show the result: what the method produced or improved
6. HALT: Ask user "Apply this? (y/n/modify)"
7. If yes → apply changes. If no → discard. If modify → adjust per feedback.
8. Re-present the 1-5,r,a,x prompt for additional methods
Select 5 NEW methods (different from current and previously shown)
Keep 1-2 relevant to current situation + 2-3 from different categories
Present new list with same prompt format
List all 60 methods grouped by category in compact format:
💡 IDEATION: 1. Audience Pain Mining | 2. Trend Hijacking | ...
🔍 RESEARCH: 7. Competitor Shadow Study | 8. Comment Gold Mining | ...
Allow user to select any method by number
After selection, execute as in case n="1-5"
Complete elicitation
Summarize all methods applied and changes made this session
Return enhanced content to calling BMAD workflow
User gives specific feedback instead of picking a number
Apply feedback directly to content and re-present choices
User picks multiple methods (e.g., "3 and 5")
Execute in sequence, each building on previous result
Show combined result, then re-offer choices
User types a category name (e.g., "hook" or "engagement")
Show all methods in that category
Allow selection from filtered list

step.title: Method Execution Guidelines
step.i: Method execution: Use description + output_pattern as process guide
Vocabulary linking: When method needs options, pull from relevant CSV
Channel awareness: Adapt method execution to target channel constraints
- LinkedIn: 800-1600 chars, no formatting, see-more hook
- Instagram: visual-first, caption secondary, hashtag heavy
- Reel: 30-60 sec script, hook in first 3 seconds
- Carousel: slide-by-slide, one point per slide
Iterative enhancement: Each method builds on previous results
Track all changes: Maintain history of what each method contributed
Quality check: After applying method, verify it improved the content
Continue until user selects 'x' to proceed
